sentences.text: Nanningosaurus was a hadrosauromorph dinosaur belonging to the family Hadrosauridae and the subfamily Lambeosaurinae.
The single known species, Nanningosaurus dashiensis, was named by Mo Jinyou and colleagues in 2007, with the genus name honoring the nearby city of Nanning.
The holotype — the specimen the species is based on — is an incomplete skeleton including the skull, arm, leg, and pelvis, while a paratype consists of a right maxilla.
Gregory S. Paul estimated the animal measured 7.5 meters long and weighed 2.5 tonnes, featuring diagnostic traits like a high maxilla branch and a curved ischium.
This dinosaur holds the distinction of being the first hadrosauroid named from southern China.

Nanningosaurus lived during the Late Cretaceous, specifically between 72 and 66 million years ago in the Maastrichtian stage, though its total time range is estimated from the Cenomanian to the Maastrichtian, between 100.5 and 66 million years ago.
Researchers suggest Nanningosaurus was a basal lambeosaurine, though they noted the support for this classification was tentative.
